name: MP Charge

Available with all weapons Type Active Element Neutral MP 0 $result_string .= sprintf("Aggro %s", $row['aggro_text']); Combo start No Combo middle Yes Range 0 Description Restore MP by charging magic power. The charging time reduces as the skill levels up. Unlike other skills, CSPD can only partially reduce this skill's Cast Time (up to a maximum 1 second reduction at 1000 CSPD); negative CSPD does not affect the cast time Staff Charge Time is shortened. Magic Device Charge Time is shortened a little. MP Heal Amount +50 Extras Show more...
